preregistration: D-424 (the author's item 3 of 2026-10-08: Phase 2 AUROC, pre and post per Phase 2 pair at L* and GRID6, with intervals, from existing caches; DESCRIPTIVE, no prediction; registered by the coordinator); details by the closest D-entries (D-181): D-361 (2) (the 63 headline cells), D-152 P5 and D-180 (the item bootstrap, B = 5000, its seeds), D-156 (AUROC is threshold-free and not re-partitioned), D-419 (3) (Duan's big-drop line: post AUROC of the frozen probe minus pre, mean over the seeds), D-382 CHOICES (n) and D-418 (the Phase 2 binding and anchor), D-419 (6) (a missing cell is kept out of n and the share, its count stated), D-412 (1) (no predicted-against-realised table, so no D-177 line)

status.rule: CLAUDE.md evidence standard: FINAL, FLAGGED (with the D-entry) or PROVISIONAL (not the registered parameters {'n_boot': 5000, 'seeds': [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], 'anchor_draws': 1000})

implementation_choices: (a) CELLS: D-361 (2)'s headline, bound by refsize_d382.p2_bind unchanged (records only; its own predictions record and final gates are not this item's, as realign_d418 calls it): the nine pairs x every layer both sides hold (GRID6 plus the pre side's L*, D-325 (2); seven per pair, 63), user-span mean, split v2, the selection's C (D-117), seeds 0-4. No C=1, last-token, cluster-level or 5% row (no such row was asked; D-361 (4)'s beside lines are not this item's).

(b) AUROC: depth_d156's block, its lines repeated (D-152 P5, D-180): metrics.auroc per seed, checked bit for bit against depth_d156.weighted_auroc with unit weights; on the v2 frozen evaluation split, not re-partitioned (D-156 keeps the item bootstrap for threshold-free quantities). pre = pre activations, pre probe; frozen = post activations, the SAME pre probe (the post AUROC); change = frozen - pre per seed, the cell's value the seed mean (D-419 (3)). No post-refit arm (not asked).

(c) INTERVALS: the D-152 P5 item bootstrap, B = 5000, eval negatives and eval positives resampled separately by paired.counts_matrix at depth_d156.ITEM_BOOT_SEED (D-180's seeds, reused as mlp_probe_d383 and hh_sensitivity_d363 reuse them; at Phase 2's sizes, 6,000 and 4,000); every seed recomputed per resample and the replicate's seed mean taken (depth_d156's expression); the same resamples for pre and frozen and at every layer, so the change's interval is paired; percentile 95% by paired.ci; per-seed intervals beside.

(d) DUAN'S FLAGS on the seed means (point estimates, D-419 (3) and realign_d418's constants): big_drop = change <= -0.05, operational_failure = frozen < 0.70, eligible = pre >= 0.75; beside, whether the change's interval lies wholly at or below -0.05 or wholly above it. Descriptive: no verdict, no prediction (D-424).

(e) ANCHOR (D-382 CHOICES (n), refsize_d382.run_p2's lines): twomoment_p2_d361.passing_anchor; at L* the probes are the selection's own fit bit for bit (selection_tpr_v2.seed_probes) and reproduce its ho20 TPRs (anchor_diffs); at EVERY computed layer the realised operating point at 1% over D-361's 1000 draws (paired.repartition_estimate, seed twomoment_p2_d361.P2_DRAW_SEED) equals the pair's D-361 record as canonical JSON. Every layer, not L* alone as realign_d418.run_p2: the AUROC is read at every layer, and that report holds the post positives' TPR, so it ties the post eval positives' scores at each layer to a committed record. Nothing is written unless all pass.

(f) MISSING (the author's 'if post-update harmful activations are missing, report it; no GPU work'): before any cache is opened, each of the seven cache files of the cell set (refsize_d382.run_p2's keys) is checked for presence in data/hidden (a regular file) and for each layer in its record's layers_resolved. A POST-side absence goes into 'missing' per (layer, cache) with the v2 items it supplies (from the v2 plan: calibration, eval negatives, eval POSITIVES); those cells are not filled (no value, no imputation) and the record is written FLAGGED (D-424). A PRE-side absence refuses: the selection's and D-361's own inputs are not this item's question, and pre and post caches share data/hidden, so a fault of the store refuses here rather than being reported as missing. SCOPE (review S2): only a POST cache FILE absent from data/hidden while its extraction record and ingest index are present reaches 'missing'; an absent post record or ingest index, or a post record whose layers_resolved lacks a required layer, already refuses inside refsize_d382.p2_bind, before this check (the layers_lacking branch is then unreachable for post caches and is kept for the pre side's report).

(g) EVIDENCE (the evidence standard: aggregates recomputable from per-item values): per filled cell the four score matrices of the v2 frozen evaluation split (negatives and positives, pre and post, one column per seed) and the seed-mean replicate arrays, in the record's npz; their sha256 in the record; the bootstrap counts are re-derivable from the seeds (their sha256 recorded). The summary recomputes every point AUROC from the stored scores and every seed-mean interval from the stored replicates before it writes.

(h) SUMMARY: the 63-cell table; the share of cells with change <= -0.05 overall, by pair, by layer number and by grid position (L* and GRID6's six positions; GRID6 differs by depth, so position is the comparable unit across pairs); a missing cell is kept out of n and the share, its count stated (D-419 (6), CHOICE 17's convention); the per-pair list with Mistral v0.1 -> v0.2 FIRST (the author: its AUROC change beside its delta TPR), each pair's L* cell beside its D-156 delta TPR from the same job. No predicted-against-realised table, so no D-177 line (D-412 (1)).

(i) LANE: one CPU list on lane C (preflight, the nine pair jobs with Mistral first, the summary), run through scripts/detach.sh with the 6-thread BLAS pin of scripts/project_env.sh as every CPU list. The preflight exits 1 on a failed record check or an absent PRE-side cache; an absent POST-side cache is printed and left to the pair job's 'missing' list (CHOICES (f)), so the author's report is written either way. No manifest job: the summary binds each pair record by its sha256 and its npz by the sha256 the record names.
(j) POPULATION GROUP: none until the pull (src/populations.py validate() needs every declared file on disk; REFSIZE_D382's and REALIGN's precedent, D-411 (4)).

config.eval_split: the v2 frozen evaluation split: its negatives against its positives (not re-partitioned, D-156)

item_bootstrap.rule: (c) INTERVALS: the D-152 P5 item bootstrap, B = 5000, eval negatives and eval positives resampled separately by paired.counts_matrix at depth_d156.ITEM_BOOT_SEED (D-180's seeds, reused as mlp_probe_d383 and hh_sensitivity_d363 reuse them; at Phase 2's sizes, 6,000 and 4,000); every seed recomputed per resample and the replicate's seed mean taken (depth_d156's expression); the same resamples for pre and frozen and at every layer, so the change's interval is paired; percentile 95% by paired.ci; per-seed intervals beside.

duan_criteria.note: Duan (arXiv:2606.15980v2, 'Benchmark Cells'): big_drop(c) = 1[dAUC(c) <= -0.05]; operational_failure(c) = 1[A_post(c) < 0.70]; eligible(c) = 1[A_base(c) >= 0.75]; read here on the seed means of the cell (change, frozen, pre); point estimates. Beside: whether the change's 95% interval lies wholly at or below -0.05, or wholly above it

config.join_rule: A v2 split's caches are its items gathered by item_id from the model's v1 caches, each item from the cache of the split v1 put it in (v1 calibration: the select record's p2wg/calibration cache; v1 eval or pool4d: the rest record's p2wg/eval or p2wg/pool4d cache), whichever v2 split it is now in; plan.items_from_v1_to_v2 counts the moved negatives by v1 and v2 split (positives stay in their v1 split). A cache keyed 'p2wg/<split>' is a v1 cache and is never read as a v2 split. Under D-307 (1) a result reads only ingested caches, so a v2 reader needs the rest caches (or their durable layer subsets) ingested and indexed first.

Every layer, not L* alone as realign_d418.run_p2: the AUROC is read at every layer, and that report holds the post positives' TPR, so it ties the post eval positives' scores at each layer to a committed record. Nothing is written unless all pass.

input_verification.rule: D-170/D-172 on Phase 2 inputs: every cache is read from data/hidden at its record's sha256, listed in its ingest index (D-307 (1)); no input is vouched for by a pin alone, so no cell carries the flag

bos_check.rule: (y) BOS check (D-361 (5), D-318 (6)): step 1 reads results/phase2/bos_check_p2.json and refuses unless both sides' models are 'ok' there: listed at the side's revision, cache_tie status 'ok', prompts_tie and plain_path ok, not in ties_failed, cache_tie_skipped or cache_tie_incomplete, and no tokenizer left unloaded; its sha256 is recorded. The LoRA line requires the base's line; the adapters are not in the scan and use the base's tokenizer (D-343).

supplies.probe_fit_rows: the probes' D-117 fit rows (pre side only)

scores_npz.keys: L<layer>|scores|<ev_pre|pos_pre|ev_post|pos_post>: (n, 5) float64 scores of the v2 frozen evaluation split's negatives and positives, pre and post, one column per seed; L<layer>|auroc|<pre|frozen|change>: (1 + B,) float64, column 0 the seed-mean point, then the B item-bootstrap replicates of the seed mean; cell_layer: the layers in the order of 'cells'
